content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the CSIR NCL Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 04-11-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CSIR NCL to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the CSIR National Chemical Laboratory (CSIR NCL) for filling up various vacancies under the organization.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised in this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertised post for this recruitment notification is Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) across multiple operational areas.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 24 vacancies have been announced by CSIR National Chemical Laboratory under the Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the starting date to apply online?
faq.answer: The online application process for CSIR NCL Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) recruitment commences on 05-10-2026 for all eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of online applications is 04-11-2026. Candidates must complete their submissions before this deadline.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC candidates is Nil, making it completely free to apply for these categories.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for SC and ST candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for SC and ST candidates is also Nil, ensuring zero fee charges for reserved categories as well.

faq.question: Q8. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants applying to the Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) posts is 25 years, with relaxations as per rules.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary structure for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) post will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 18000 to 56900 Per Month.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I apply online for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by visiting the official recruitment portal of CSIR NCL at https://recruit.ncl.res.in before the last date.
